observations.behavior: Checks if the connection is backed by DuckDB/duckgres, which lack server-side cursor support.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks DuckDB compatibility before using server-side cursors; DuckDB connections do not support `DECLARE CURSOR` and lack `pg_catalog.pg_cursors`.

observations.behavior: Adds DuckDB compatibility check to the cursor factory selection, excluding DuckDB from server-side cursor usage.

observations.posthog_connection: DuckDB connections are excluded from using psycopg's ServerCursor, which requires server-side cursor support.
